name: QuickBooks Online
description: QuickBooks Online as agent tools. Ask about invoices, bills, customers, vendors and money owed, or pull any of the eleven financial reports — balance sheet, profit and loss, cash flow, trial balance, general ledger, A/R and A/P ageing and the rest. Each workspace connects its own QuickBooks company under Settings, Integrations; the plugin stores no credentials of its own.

permissions.label: Read QuickBooks
permissions.description: See invoices, bills, customers, vendors and financial reports from the workspace's QuickBooks company.

permissions.label: Change QuickBooks records
permissions.description: Let the agent create, update and delete records in QuickBooks on this user's behalf. Grant sparingly — these actions post to the company's real accounting records.

roles.label: QuickBooks Admin
roles.description: Read everything, and let the agent create, update and delete records in QuickBooks.

roles.label: QuickBooks Reader
roles.description: Read invoices, bills, contacts and reports. Cannot change anything in QuickBooks.

setup.instructions: Connect your QuickBooks company under Settings, Integrations — Eesa runs the Intuit sign-in and holds the connection for this workspace. Nothing needs configuring here. Until a company is connected the tools reply that QuickBooks is not connected yet. Whether the agent may CHANGE anything depends on two things: the deployment's QUICKBOOKS_DISABLE_WRITE/UPDATE/DELETE switches, and the 'Change QuickBooks records' permission granted to that user. This deployment currently has write and update enabled and delete disabled.
